summary_en: D2RM is a markerless extrinsic-calibration method for a monocular optical camera and a multi-beam forward-looking imaging sonar. It converts each ambiguous sonar return into a sampled pseudo-pointcloud, derives a lightweight camera depth proxy from an underwater light-attenuation prior, and maximizes mutual information between the two depth domains to estimate planar translation and yaw. Experiments on simulated water conditions and a real turbid pier-inspection dataset report improved projected-inlier scores over depth-to-depth baselines while avoiding heavy GPU depth models.
